blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the ₱563.29 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the ₱30.63 million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Friday, Nov. 20, 2026. According to the PCSO results provided, the winning combination for Ultra Lotto 6/58 was 51-22-34-27-01-24, with a jackpot prize of ₱563.29 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. READ: Lotto Results Today – November 20, 2026 Mega Lotto 6/45 also produced no jackpot winner. The winning combination was 31-24-26-04-42-09, with a jackpot prize of ₱30.63 million.
